headline_hint: Why Gartner (IT) stock is down today
instructions: The move is happening now. Use the latest quote; if the session has closed by the time you write, use the close and say so. The company reported results today or last night: make the results the cause, and link the recap if one exists.

facts.name: Gartner
sentences: Gartner's shares moved 5% or more on 30 of the last 252 sessions.
The last move at least this big in the same direction was on 22 October 2026, when the stock rose 6.8%.
The stock is down 6.8% this year, and at $235.26 it sits 7.6% below its 52-week closing high of $254.59 from 30 December 2025.
$1,000 invested in Gartner five years ago would be worth $693 today.
